fieldDescription: Added to the career points you have earned (or taken away, below zero). Use it to set your total by hand. The store of a game already in progress sees the change at once.
Career points paid for every level you gain, in any save. Each save pays each level once. Levels bought in the store pay nothing.
Every store price is multiplied by this, then rounded. 1.0 keeps the listed prices, 0.5 halves them, 2.0 doubles them.
